name: Elder and Vulnerable Customer Financial Abuse
description: Older or vulnerable people are exploited by relatives, carers, scammers or persons holding power of attorney. Warning signs include sudden changes in banking behaviour and the presence of third parties directing transactions.

sources.text: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)
UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)
FCA, Guidance for firms on the fair treatment of vulnerable customers (FG21/1, 2021)

exposure.rationale: Third-party directed withdrawals and transfers; branch intervention.

indicators.name: Uncharacteristic large withdrawals or transfers
indicators.desc: Transactions or withdrawals are uncharacteristic of, or inconsistent with, the customer's known profile, income or expected activity.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: unusual cash or transfers inconsistent with usual pattern.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)

indicators.name: Third party accompanies and directs the customer
indicators.canon: Customer accompanied, directed or coached by a third party
indicators.desc: Another person speaks for, accompanies or dictates instructions to the customer, who may appear fearful, scripted or unable to explain the activity.
indicators.ctx: Another person speaks for the customer or dictates instructions.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)

indicators.name: New joint account holder or power of attorney added
indicators.canon: New joint account holder or power of attorney added
indicators.desc: Access given to a new person shortly before unusual activity.
indicators.ctx: Access given to a new person shortly before unusual activity.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)

indicators.name: Confusion or fear about own finances
indicators.canon: Confusion or fear about own finances
indicators.desc: Customer appears unsure of balances, recent transactions or reason for payments.
indicators.ctx: Customer appears unsure of balances, recent transactions or reason for payments.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)

indicators.name: Sudden new spending on unrelated person
indicators.canon: Sudden new spending on unrelated person
indicators.desc: Frequent payments or purchases benefiting a carer or acquaintance.
indicators.ctx: Frequent payments or purchases benefiting a carer or acquaintance.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)

indicators.name: Frequent ATM use by carer or unusual card use
indicators.canon: Frequent ATM use by carer or unusual card use
indicators.desc: Cards used where customer is unlikely to be present.
indicators.ctx: Cards used where customer is unlikely to be present.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)

indicators.name: Customer targeted by scams
indicators.desc: repeated scam payments or telephone contacts.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: repeated scam payments or telephone contacts.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)

indicators.name: Changes to statements delivery, address or contact
indicators.canon: Recent change of contact or delivery details
indicators.desc: Email, phone, address or statement delivery details are changed, especially shortly before unusual activity or redirecting mail to a third party.
indicators.ctx: Mail redirected to a third party.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)

indicators.name: Property or investment sold under pressure
indicators.canon: Property or investment sold under pressure
indicators.desc: Large assets liquidated with hurried instructions.
indicators.ctx: Large assets liquidated with hurried instructions.
refs: FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)
